name: cache-clock
description: Status line with context, cost, how long the prompt cache stays warm, and 5-hour and weekly usage, then model (effort), cwd and branch, plus a Keep warm button while the cache cools.

fallbackTtl.title: Fallback cache TTL
fallbackTtl.description: TTL to assume when API usage carries no ephemeral_1h/5m split. Defaults to 1h, the session's usual TTL; none keeps the clock dark until a split is seen.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names drawn red in the status line, as a reminder not to commit there. Empty flags none.
